en.title: Netherlands Moves Gold Out of US Amid Geopolitical Concerns
en.hook: The Netherlands is repatriating its gold reserves from the US, citing fears of geopolitical instability, raising questions about global financial security.
key_takeaways: Netherlands withdraws gold from US custody
Potential impact on international trust in US gold storage
